traits.desc: The lesser scrag regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it is in contact with water. If the scrag takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the scrag's next turn. The scrag dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.
